title: Raw composite exchange coherence
statement: Fix a prime l and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. Index coefficients by the finite intermediate fields E of Ω/Q_l, as in [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Let f : X → S, g : T → S, h : Y → X and e : Y → T be a chosen cartesian square [sbc-def-base-change-square], with all four schemes noetherian and of finite topological Krull dimension and with l invertible on each. Use the completed coefficient systems of [def-sbc-ambient-complete-coefficient-categories] and the operations and predicates of [def-sbc-finite-stage-rational-exchange-data]. For each of f,g,h,e, suppose integral comparisons pPush,pPull and raw scalar-system morphisms rPush,rPull are given, satisfying HasOperationCoherence. There exist raw scalar-system morphisms F,G from the T-system to the X-system whose stage functors are the canonical rational composites (push g followed by pull f, and pull e followed by push h). They are additive with identity reflexive comparisons. Their β are the composites of the given operation β; on localized integral objects they equal the localizations of the corresponding integral comparison composites, conjugated by the specified integral/raw tensor comparisons. There is a compatible Hom F G whose stage transformations are heterogeneously equal to the canonical sbcRationalExchange. Thus the raw canonical exchange obeys the coefficient square, without any assertion of invertibility or Karoubi extension.

proof.text:
Compose the raw operation comparisons to define
$$b^F=(P_M^f d^g)(p^fD_E^g),\qquad b^G=(D_M^h p^e)(d^hP_E^e).$$
These are the raw extensions of the integral composites, by step 4. The final clause of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] concerns the exchange $\gamma\circ\Lambda_X(b_K)$ for complete $K$: here $b_K:Lf^*Rg_*K\to Rh_*Le^*K$ is the ambient mate of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange], $\Lambda$ is derived completion with unit $\kappa$, and $\gamma:\Lambda_XRh_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rh_*\Lambda_Y$ is the arrow of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-pushforward-completion], so $\gamma\kappa=Rh_*(\kappa)$. We identify it with $\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_E$. By [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] $P_u=\Lambda Lu^*$ with completion unit $k_u$, hence $(\gamma\Lambda_X(b_K))k_{f,D_gK}=\gamma\kappa b_K=R_h(k_{e,K})b_K$. The canonical composition isomorphisms of step 1 are the conjugates of direct-image composition for $P_u\dashv D_u$; [lem-sbc-reflected-compositor-unit-normalization] gives $c^ck\,L(k)=k\,c$ for each of the two compositors, and composing these identities gives $\theta^c_Mk_{h,P_fM}L_h(k_{f,M})=k_{e,P_gM}L_e(k_{g,M})\theta_M$. Thus [lem-sbc-reflector-square-mate-factorization] applies, and its uniqueness clause gives $\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{E,K}=\gamma\Lambda_X(b_K)$; likewise at $M$. Step 2 then identifies the rationalizations. With the square labeled $(f,g,h,e)$, the clause is exactly
$$\alpha_M^{\mathrm{raw}}(T^T_{M/E}K)b^{F,\mathrm{raw}}_{M/E,K}=b^{G,\mathrm{raw}}_{M/E,K}T^X_{M/E}(\alpha_E^{\mathrm{raw}}(K)).$$
All four schemes satisfy that node's noetherian, finite-dimensional and invertible-$\ell$ hypotheses. Its ambient clause applies without assuming constructible landing.

proof.text:
The composite comparisons also satisfy the tower equation. Use notation $U,V,W$ for the raw scalar transitions at the source, middle and target of $H_E:A_E\to B_E$, $J_E:B_E\to D_E$. Write $b=b^H$, $c=b^J$, and $k_{M/E}=J_M(b_{M/E})(c_{M/E}H_E)$. This is $b^F$ for $(H,J)=(D^g,P^f)$ and $b^G$ for $(P^e,D^h)$. The prescribed tower equation is that of [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent]. Suppress object arguments and write juxtaposition for composition, retaining right whiskerings. Expanding the left side and substituting the individual tower equations from steps 3-4 gives
$$
\begin{aligned}
k_{P/E}(a^D J_EH_E)
&=J_P(b_{P/E})(c_{P/E}H_E)(a^DJ_EH_E)\\
&=J_P(b_{P/E}a^B H_E)(c_{P/M}V_{M/E}H_E)(W_{P/M}c_{M/E}H_E)\\
&=J_PH_P(a^A)(J_Pb_{P/M}U_{M/E})(J_PV_{P/M}b_{M/E})
(c_{P/M}V_{M/E}H_E)(W_{P/M}c_{M/E}H_E).
\end{aligned}
$$
Naturality of $c_{P/M}$ at $b_{M/E,K}$ replaces the middle product by
$$(J_PV_{P/M}b_{M/E})(c_{P/M}V_{M/E}H_E)
=(c_{P/M}H_MU_{M/E})(W_{P/M}J_Mb_{M/E}).$$
The resulting expression is exactly
$$J_PH_P(a^A)(k_{P/M}U_{M/E})(W_{P/M}k_{M/E}),$$
the required tower right side. The unit comparison is $(J_E1)(1H_E)=1$. Step 9 now gives these equations on the Karoubi envelopes with the specified scalar associators of [def-sbc-ambient-complete-coefficient-categories].

theorem rationalRawSquareExchangeCoherence
    (cf_pPush : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) f ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω S a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω X a ⋙
        sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) f)
    (cf_pPull : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) f ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω X a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω S a ⋙
        sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) f)
    (cf_rPush : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω X)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω S))
    (cf_rPull : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω S)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω X))
    (cg_pPush : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) g ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω S a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω T a ⋙
        sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) g)
    (cg_pPull : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) g ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω T a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω S a ⋙
        sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) g)
    (cg_rPush : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω T)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω S))
    (cg_rPull : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω S)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω T))
    (ch_pPush : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) h ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω X a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω Y a ⋙
        sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) h)
    (ch_pPull : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) h ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω Y a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω X a ⋙
        sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) h)
    (ch_rPush : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω Y)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω X))
    (ch_rPull : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω X)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω Y))
    (ce_pPush : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) e ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω T a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω Y a ⋙
        sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) e)
    (ce_pPull : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M),
    sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) e ⋙
        pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω Y a ≅
      pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralTransition l Ω T a ⋙
        sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) e)
    (ce_rPush : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω Y)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω T))
    (ce_rPull : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω T)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω Y))
    (hf : HasOperationCoherence l Ω f cf_pPush cf_pPull cf_rPush cf_rPull)
    (hg : HasOperationCoherence l Ω g cg_pPush cg_pPull cg_rPush cg_rPull)
    (hh : HasOperationCoherence l Ω h ch_pPush ch_pPull ch_rPush ch_rPull)
    (he : HasOperationCoherence l Ω e ce_pPush ce_pPull ce_rPush ce_rPull) :
  ∃ (rawF : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω T)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω X)),
  ∃ (rawG : StageSystem.Morphism (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω T)
    (pbcAmbientCompleteRawSystem l Ω X)),
  ∃ (_rawF_eq : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω),
    rawF.Φ E = sbcRationalLeft l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) (f := f) (g := g)),
  ∃ (_rawG_eq : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω),
    rawG.Φ E = sbcRationalRight l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) (e := e) (h := h)),
  ∃ (_rawF_additive : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω), (rawF.Φ E).Additive),
  ∃ (_rawG_additive : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω), (rawG.Φ E).Additive),
  ∃ (_rawF_unit : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω),
    HEq (rawF.β (le_refl E)) (Iso.refl (rawF.Φ E))),
  ∃ (_rawG_unit : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω),
    HEq (rawG.β (le_refl E)) (Iso.refl (rawG.Φ E))),
  ∃ (_rawF_composite : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M)
      (K : pbcAmbientCompleteStage l Ω T E),
    HEq ((rawF.β a).hom.app K)
      ((cf_rPull.β a).hom.app ((cg_rPush.Φ E).obj K) ≫
        (cf_rPull.Φ M).map ((cg_rPush.β a).hom.app K))),
  ∃ (_rawG_composite : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M)
      (K : pbcAmbientCompleteStage l Ω T E),
    HEq ((rawG.β a).hom.app K)
      ((ch_rPush.β a).hom.app ((ce_rPull.Φ E).obj K) ≫
        (ch_rPush.Φ M).map ((ce_rPull.β a).hom.app K))),
  ∃ (_rawF_normalization : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M)
      (K : PbcComplete l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T),
    HEq ((rawF.β a).hom.app ((pbcAmbientCompleteLocalization l Ω T E).obj K))
      ((pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralComparison l Ω X a).hom.app
          ((sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) f).obj
            ((sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) g).obj K)) ≫
        (pbcAmbientCompleteLocalization l Ω X M).map
          ((cf_pPull a).hom.app
              ((sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) g).obj K) ≫
            (sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) f).map
              ((cg_pPush a).hom.app K)) ≫
        (sbcRationalLeft l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M)
          (f := f) (g := g)).map
          ((pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralComparison l Ω T a).inv.app K))),
  ∃ (_rawG_normalization : ∀ {E M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (a : E ≤ M)
      (K : PbcComplete l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T),
    HEq ((rawG.β a).hom.app ((pbcAmbientCompleteLocalization l Ω T E).obj K))
      ((pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralComparison l Ω X a).hom.app
          ((sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) h).obj
            ((sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) e).obj K)) ≫
        (pbcAmbientCompleteLocalization l Ω X M).map
          ((ch_pPush a).hom.app
              ((sbcPull l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) e).obj K) ≫
            (sbcPush l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M) h).map
              ((ce_pPull a).hom.app K)) ≫
        (sbcRationalRight l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω M)
          (h := h) (e := e)).map
          ((pbcAmbientCompleteIntegralComparison l Ω T a).inv.app K))),
  ∃ (rawAlpha : StageSystem.Morphism.Hom rawF rawG),
  ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω), HEq (rawAlpha.τ E)
    (sbcRationalExchange l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) sq)
